notes_for_editor: Brief had Klamath/Douglas, USFS, gone, access unknown; the register and firelookout.com agree on a 1930s cab that is gone. No staffing, fire or access source was found for this Mule Peak. The two searches returned only Union County (Wallowa-Whitman, elev. 8,679 ft) and California Mule Peak pages, which were not used for this record; the Union County lookout appears in one disambiguation sentence in the story. The brief's kind 'ground' is not stated in any source read, so it is left out of facts. Not read: cedarcountrylumber.net 2021 re-roof post and cherylhill.net 2023 Mule Peak page, both probably the Union County site.
